messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync: need a lean co-sell handoff for the new marketplace + HW partner pilot. Last month we had 3 dropped claims and slow joint announce sequencing. Thoughts?

jake (sales): Agree. Sales needs clear timers. Ambiguity = cold deals. Can we define a hard claim window? :thinking_face:

sunil (solutions): Suggestion: default 24h claim window from intake notification. If ARR >= $250k or opp stage >= Demo, AE auto-owns immediately. If not claimed in 24h, return to partnerships queue.

olga (pm): Two product constraints: 1) auto-write SFDC tags on claim, 2) link marketplace listing state to announcement gating (if listing != PUBLISHED then block external announce).

maria (partnerships): Minimal SFDC tags: si_claimed_by, si_claim_ts, marketplace_state. Keeps reporting simple.

sunil (solutions): Intake pseudo-rule we'll deploy: SELECT id FROM intake WHERE si_interest=1 AND (ARR>=250000 OR stage IN ('Demo','POC')) AND si_claim_ts IS NULL ORDER BY created_ts LIMIT 1. If none claimed within 24h set claimed_by=partnerships_queue.

jake (sales): How to handle contested accounts? Field rep vs SI claim often. Need tie-breakers.

sunil (solutions): Tie-breakers: 1) AE activity count last 30 days > 2 => AE wins. 2) else first technical activity timestamp wins. 3) still tied -> partnerships-ops adjudicate within 24h.

maria (partnerships): We'll add a small adjudication flow and a Slack template: `@partnerships-ops adjudicate: lead <id> contested by <A> <B>`.

olga (pm): UI: add states on intake card and two metrics: activities_last_30d and first_tech_activity_ts so adjudication is visible.

nina (legal): For co-branded announcements: legal review 3 business days after partner PM signoff. For hardware partners add 2 business days for compliance/export checks if flagged. Automate notifications but not approvals.

maria (partnerships): Proposed state flow for intake card: NEW -> CLAIMED -> TECH_SYNC -> PM_SIGNOFF -> LEGAL_REVIEW -> MARKETPLACE_PENDING -> PUBLISHED. Each state gets owner + SLA timer.

jake (sales): If we trial 24h window, what metrics are we tracking?

sunil (solutions): Track: claim_rate_within_24h, contested_count, avg_time_to_publish, legal_block_rate. We'll expose weekly dashboard.

maria (partnerships): Action items: 1) eng add SFDC auto-tags (sunil), 2) intake UI state + metrics (olga), 3) legal SLA automation (nina), 4) partnerships ops playbook & Slack template (maria).

partnerships-ops-bot: Reminder set: SI co-sell handoff check-in every Thursday 10:00 PT.

maria (partnerships): I'll drop a 1-pager with mapping rules and the SLA table in this thread by EOD tomorrow. If no objections, start 24h claim pilot next Monday. :thumbsup:
